Role based view only access to ORBIT
issues.description:
As an admin or Organization Manager, I want to be able to assign users a read-only role at the organization or layer level so that they can see the status of people within the org / layer but not have access to modify any content. 

Acceptance criteria:
* When admin / org manager creates a new role, they can select the option "Read Only"
* When "Read Only" option is selected, the admin/org manager can select a layer
* A user assigned the Read Only role can view, but not edit or update, check-in information for people in the org / layer

issues.title: Allow for Training Waiver
issues.description:
As a Layer Manager, I want to be able to mark a person exempt from training / tasks and provide a reason for why they are exempt.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

Layer Manager
- User Employee page includes an option for Layer Manager to exempt user from training
- Default is "not exempt"
- If "exempt" is selected, there is a mandatory "reason" field
 User
- User does not see Tasks on home page
- User does not see Tasks on Profile
- User does not see Tasks in menu

System
- Task exemption status stored in SQL Server Reporting database
- Task exemption reason stored in SQL Server Reporting database
- Layer Mananger name who exempted user stored in SQL Server Reporting database

TASKS

- Add Task exemption boolean and reason to employee form
- Update Home page to not show Tasks if user is exempt
- Update Profile page to not show Tasks if user is exempt
- Update navigation menu to not show Tasks if user is exempt
- Update tables in SQL Server Reporting database

_Original customer request: 
- Enhance the Exempt feature to include exempt from Check-In and/or Training, allow to select check-in, training or both
- Add an exempt end date 
- Have an exemption form that HR POCs can use to submit a request to HQ for a member which would show up under Alerts on the main page for HQ approval. 
- HQ would then mark the member as exempt with an end date and they would choose check-in, training or both. 
- Generate an automated email to the HR POC and HQ to remind them of the end date a week in advance._

issues.title: Implement Content Filtering for Contracts page (Active, Inactive, All)
issues.description:
As a user with access to the Contracts page (in Customer Settings panel), I want the Contracts page to display only Active items by default when the page is loaded, even though all data (active and inactive) is retrieved. I want to be able to switch between "Active", "Inactive", and "All" items using a filter implemented on the page. The currently selected filter option should be highlighted and disabled to indicate the active filter. 

Acceptance Criteria: 
- Page retrieves all data (active and inactive)
- Default view shows only Active items
- Filter options are available for "Active", "Inactive", and "All" 
- Filtering is performed entirely on the client-side
- Selected filter option is highlighted and disabled
- UI is responsive and accessible
